slides.heading: Ebola Virus Disease
slides.subtitle: A severe viral hemorrhagic illness spread through body secretions.

slides.heading: Overview
bullets: Mode of transmission: human-to-human exposure to body secretions (except sweat); vector animals.

slides.heading: 5 Causative Strains
rows: Present in the Philippines; affects pigs

slides.heading: Key Takeaways
bullets: Ebola spreads via body secretions (except sweat); incubation 2–21 days.
Five strains — the Reston strain is present in the Philippines and affects pigs.
Requires strict isolation and barrier precautions.
